title: Markdown preview is bypassed for text-classified Markdown files
reasoning: The Markdown branch is ordered after the generic text/sourceCode branch. Any .md file whose contentType conforms to .text takes showText and returns before showMarkdown can run, so the intended Markdown rendering path is skipped for the common typed-file path.
reproduction: Select a .md FileItem whose contentType conforms to .text. updateSelection calls showText at lines 132-134 and never reaches showMarkdown.
recommendation: Check the .md extension or UTType.markdown before the generic text/sourceCode branch, then fall back to showText for other text types.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no included PreviewPaneController tests or preview routing tests for Markdown versus plain text.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a FileItem for a temporary .md file with a text-conforming content type, call updateSelection, and assert the text storage contains heading attributes from renderMarkdown rather than the monospaced plain-text path.
